title: Unit-test agent result
description: Structured result of one unit-test-engineer run. Narrative only: the files changed and the test outcomes reported in the pull request are computed independently by CI.

summary.description: Two or three plain-text sentences for reviewers: what was analyzed and why the tests were (not) changed.

targets.description: One entry per target from the plan, in plan order.

decision.description: created: new test file; updated: cases added to or adjusted in an existing test file; no_change_needed: existing tests already cover the changed behaviour or the change is not unit-observable; skipped: could not be handled (explain why).

behaviours.description: Behaviours the new or updated tests pin down, one short phrase each.

local_result.description: Result of the last local run of the affected test files.

findings.description: Observations for humans. Never fix production code; report it here.
